definition.name: theta-idempotent-approximation-map
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:505-528, definitional displays only): f(X)=a_0I+\sum a_n(X-x_0I)^n if ||X-x_0I||<r with ||f(X)-f(x_0I)|| <= \sum|a_n| ||X-x_0I||^n; |X|=(X^2)^{1/2}, sgn(X)=X(X^2)^{-1/2} (||X^2-x_0^2I||<x_0^2); \wt{P}=\theta(2P-I) where \theta(X)=(I+\sgn(X))/2.
